summary: Learn MAXQDA project setup, coding, case comparison, and mixed methods integration. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: MAXQDA training helps researchers, evaluators, and analysts organize materials and apply a consistent codebook. You practise coding and retrieving source material, comparing cases with document variables, and recording analytic decisions in memos. The course also covers creating a mixed methods display that connects qualitative themes with quantitative summaries and preparing findings for review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who need to organize, code, compare, or report qualitative evidence in MAXQDA. It suits beginners who work with research or evaluation data and want a repeatable analysis workflow.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop with access to MAXQDA installed. You should be familiar with a research question and with at least one source type such as interview transcripts, focus-group records, or documents. No programming is required. Use only non-confidential materials you are authorized to analyse, with identifying details removed.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
